    MultiplicativeBasisDeformations.FlatPert.flat_perturbation_right

    Lemma 12.3 for right modules and first arrows #

    lem:flat-mesh-perturbations is stated for right modules, splitting each relation by its first arrow; flat_perturbation uses the representables C(−, x) and last arrows. This file states the lemma in the manuscript's convention and derives it from the opposite quiver: path reversal gives isomorphisms kQ(w, y) ≅ kQᵒᵖ(y, w) reversing composition (opE), carrying the ideals of C and B to those of the opposite presentation, and the first-arrow presentations of the right simple modules to the last-arrow presentations of the representables of Qᵒᵖ.

                                              Lemma 12.3 (lem:flat-mesh-perturbations), in the source's convention: let C = kQ/(r₁, …, r_t) be a graded presentation with relations of degree at least two such that the presentations of the right simple modules obtained by splitting each relation by its first arrow are projective resolutions of length at most two (hC: at every w, the relation map is injective and its image is the kernel of the arrow map), let C_d = 0 for d ≥ N (hN) and let f_i be parallel to r_i of strictly higher degree. Then B = kQ/(𝔪^{N+1}, r_i − f_i) has gr_𝔪 B ≅ C (in every degree d, paths induce C_d(w, y) ≅ 𝔪^d B(w, y)/𝔪^{d+1} B(w, y)), the dimensions of C, every path basis of C lifts to a basis of B, and splitting the perturbed relations by their first arrows gives projective resolutions of the right simple modules of B.
